thread:
sanjay: quick heads-up — during bring-up of llamaX-large (v1.2.0) with int8 quant we hit reproducible divergence after ~46k tokens when `kv_shrink` is enabled (policy: shrink_at=40960). happens on both p4d and a100 nodes. repro script attached below. :thinking:

marta: can you paste the exact cmd + minimal repro? also which compilation flags (fused-attn, rotary_scale?)

sanjay: minimal repro: `./bin/infer --model=llamaX-large --quant=int8 --max-tokens=50000 --kv-shrink=40960 --seed=1234 --stream=false`
logs show repeated entity hallucination starting ~46012 tokens and attention maps look 'streaky'. snippet of runtime debug: `KV_INDEX_MAP: [0..40959] -> shrink -> [0..32767]` then later `ROPE_OFFSET_WRAP: true` and `ATTN_SUM_SHIFT: +0.00012`

ci-bot: load-test #342 completed. result: perf ok, accuracy regression flagged (delta ppl +1.7 vs fp16 baseline). See: https://ci.internal/tests/342

liam: interesting. hypothesis: kv_shrink truncates early KV buckets and runtime reuses older rotary phase bases — when sequence > window we get phase alignment mismatch. could be RoPE scaling + quant rounding interaction. try disabling kv_shrink or bumping `rotary_scale` slightly. also compare with `--kv-cache=full` to check if shrink is the culprit. :eyes:

sanjay: did quick check: fp16 baseline (no shrink) PPL=11.2 on longdoc eval; int8+kvshrink PPL=12.9. int8 without shrink (kv_cache=full) PPL=11.4. so shrink + int8 is the combo. sample divergence: repeated last-name tokens and a silent drift in punctuation placement.

eva: can you run deterministic run with `--seed=42` and `--kv-eviction=none` and capture `attn_scores` + `kv_index_map` logs? add `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kv_map,attn_scores` env var. also capture the generated token IDs to diff against baseline. i suspect an off-by-one in eviction pointer.

marta: also try setting `rotary_scale=1.03` and `rotary_scale=0.97` as a quick sensitivity test — if output/attn stabilizes it's a rot-phase numeric edge. if it doesn't, focus on kv index bookkeeping.

olivia: i'll schedule an overnight sweep across quant backends (int8, int8_opt, q4_0) and kv_shrink thresholds [32768,40960,49152] on both a100/p4d. adding a canary job to the rollout: `canary.kv_shrink=false` for 10% traffic until we root cause. i'll post results in morning. :white_check_mark:

liam: if you can repro locally, try a micro-test: feed repeating prefix of length 50k, then append unique token and assert token-level hash at 50k+1 equals baseline. that isolates cache mapping. example: `python tests/longctx_hash.py --len 50050 --model ...`

sanjay: running eva's deterministic test now, will attach diffs. quick paste of token-hash mismatch at 46013: `baseline_hash=0x7f3a2, int8_shrink_hash=0x3c21b` — different.

ci-bot: job #343 started (deterministic longctx sweep).

marta: also dump `kv_positions` at checkpoint boundaries (every 8192 tokens) — if positions reset or jump we have a bookkeeping bug. small script: `python -c "from runtime import KV; print(KV.positions())"` every checkpoint.

olivia: FYI added monitoring alert: `longctx_kv_hash_mismatch` if mismatch rate > 0.1% over 10k tokens. linked to runbook `ops/runbooks/kv-shrink-longctx.md` (WIP).

liam: another angle: quantized kernel tiling may change accumulation ordering -> tiny float deltas accumulate across long contexts and with shrink you reindex older keys to new tiles. try fp16 tiled vs non-tiled to see if tiling plays a role.

sanjay: thanks all — will post deterministic diffs and a short sample of generated text highlighting the divergence. opening a tracker ticket after I collect logs: INF-2298.

marta: cheers. if you want pair debugging tomorrow ping me @marta. :coffee:
